selection_rule: support >= 2; mean train fraction >= .75; prefer 10 repeats; then lowest median repeat-mean Macro F1 SD; then largest train fraction
reason: Four folds keep two quality-3 and at least three quality-8 observations per validation fold, retaining 75% for training. Five folds retain 80% but allow only one quality-3 and two quality-8 observations. Ten repeats characterize split sensitivity; they do not create more independent rare-class observations.
